{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "# Build a playful static editorial website for a dental community event

Project Name: **SmileFest 2026 – A Playful Dental Wellness Event Site**

Please create a **fully static front-end website** using **Vue** for a fun dental event. It should feel like an Instagram-inspired editorial/landing page for a cheerful dental wellness festival, not a corporate clinic site. No backend, no database, no login, no payment, no real APIs. All content can be mock/static/sample data inside the project.

---

## Overall Concept

SmileFest 2026 is a one-day community dental wellness event with mini talks, kids activities, oral care demos, smile photo corners, dentist Q&A, and free hygiene education. The website should look playful, friendly, colorful, and modern. Think:

- Instagram profile/feed energy
- Story highlight bubbles
- Cute dental icons
- Soft pastel gradients
- Rounded cards
- Editorial magazine sections
- Fun captions and micro-copy
- Simple scroll-based layout
- Mobile-first but beautiful desktop too

The site should be static only and work as a marketing/editorial event page.

---

## Tech Requirements

Use:
- Vue 3
- HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Component-based structure
- Static local content only
- Responsive layout

Do NOT use:
- Backend
- API calls
- Authentication
- Database
- Admin panel
- Real booking/payment system
- Maps API
- External live social media embeds
- WebGL / Three.js / 3D

If you need event posts, agenda items, dentists, captions, etc. just create sample arrays/static JSON inside the frontend.

---

## Visual Direction

Style: Playful editorial website
Reference feeling: Instagram but custom, not a clone
Theme: Dental event / smile festival

Color palette idea:
- Bubblegum pink: #FF7EB6
- Mint toothpaste: #7DE2D1
- Sky blue: #8CCBFF
- Cream white: #FFF8EF
- Grape purple: #8B5CF6
- Sunshine yellow: #FFD166
- Soft charcoal text: #263238

Typography:
- Big rounded headings
- Friendly sans-serif body text
- Use strong hierarchy like editorial magazine layout

Design motifs:
- Tooth stickers
- Sparkle icons
- Smile curves
- Brush stroke dividers
- Instagram-like post cards
- Story rings
- Polaroid/photo booth cards
- Rounded pill tags
- Confetti shapes

---

## Required Pages / Sections

This can be a single-page static site with anchored sections.

### 1. Sticky Top Navigation

Include:
- Logo: SmileFest 2026
- Nav links: Home, Stories, Schedule, Speakers, Smile Gallery, FAQ
- CTA button: Get Event Details

Mobile:
- Simple hamburger or stacked compact menu
- Keep it lightweight and static

Nav style:
- Rounded glassy bar
- Pastel background
- Small tooth icon near logo

---

### 2. Hero Section

Hero should feel like the top of an exciting Instagram event campaign.

Content:
- Small badge: “Community Dental Day • July 18, 2026”
- Headline: “A brighter smile party for kids, families & curious grown-ups”
- Subtext: “Join SmileFest for playful dental education, mini checkup demos, oral-care challenges, smile photo moments, and bite-sized talks from friendly dental pros.”
- Buttons:
  - View Schedule
  - Explore Smile Stories

Visual right side:
Create an Instagram-inspired collage:
- Main event poster card
- Mini post card with caption
- Story bubbles
- Floating stat cards:
  - 12 Smile Sessions
  - 8 Dental Experts
  - 300+ Happy Visitors Expected
  - Free Toothbrush Kits

Make it static, no real social media integration.

---

### 3. Instagram Story Highlight Strip

Horizontal story highlight style row.

Items:
- Kids Zone
- Brush Tips
- Dentist Q&A
- Smile Booth
- Snack Lab
- Parent Guide
- Free Kits

Each should be circular with gradient ring and cute emoji/icon.

Interaction:
- Simple hover effect only
- No modal needed unless easy, but static content is okay

---

### 4. Editorial Intro Section

Create a magazine-like block with large text and side notes.

Title: “Why SmileFest exists”

Copy:
“Dental care can feel scary, expensive, or confusing. SmileFest turns oral health into something warm, visual, and easy to understand. Families can learn practical brushing habits, ask real questions, explore smile-friendly snacks, and celebrate healthy routines together.”

Add 3 editorial callout cards:
- Learn without pressure
- Play your way to better habits
- Meet friendly dental professionals

Use playful illustrations/icons.

---

### 5. Event Schedule Section

Make schedule cards with time, title, tag, short description.

Sample agenda:

9:30 AM – Doors Open + Smile Stickers
Tag: Welcome
Description: Pick up your event card, toothbrush kit, and sticker sheet.

10:00 AM – Tiny Teeth Big Habits
Tag: Kids Talk
Description: A colorful mini session about brushing, flossing, and making routines fun.

11:00 AM – Ask a Dentist Anything
Tag: Live Q&A
Description: Friendly answers to common parent and patient questions.

12:00 PM – Smile-Friendly Snack Lab
Tag: Food Education
Description: Learn which snacks are kind to teeth and which ones need extra care.

1:30 PM – Brushing Challenge Game
Tag: Activity
Description: Practice timing, angles, and gentle brushing with oversized demo models.

2:30 PM – Confidence & Smiles Panel
Tag: Editorial Talk
Description: A relaxed conversation about dental anxiety, prevention, and confidence.

3:30 PM – Photo Booth + Closing Giveaway
Tag: Fun Moment
Description: Snap a smile card and grab final take-home resources.

Design:
- Timeline or grid cards
- Use pastel tag pills
- Hover lift animation

---

### 6. Speaker / Dental Expert Cards

Static profile cards, Instagram profile inspired.

Include 4 sample speakers:

1. Dr. Mia Lane
Role: Pediatric Dentist
Caption: “Making tiny teeth feel like a big adventure.”
Topics: Kids brushing, dental anxiety, parent routines

2. Dr. Noah Patel
Role: Preventive Care Specialist
Caption: “Small habits today, fewer surprises tomorrow.”
Topics: Fluoride, checkups, daily prevention

3. Sofia Chen, RDH
Role: Dental Hygienist
Caption: “Flossing is a skill, not a personality test.”
Topics: Floss technique, gum health, hygiene basics

4. Lina Brooks
Role: Smile Wellness Educator
Caption: “Healthy smiles should feel friendly and doable.”
Topics: Snack choices, habit tracking, family routines

Card details:
- Avatar placeholder using colored circles/initials or simple illustrated style
- Follow-style button that says “View Topic” but not functional beyond hover
- Stats like Posts / Tips / Sessions but static

---

### 7. Smile Gallery / Instagram Feed Section

Create a mock Instagram grid editorial gallery.

Use 9 static cards/posts with captions. No real Instagram embed.

Post examples:
- “How long should brushing really take?”
- “The snack swap that makes dentists smile”
- “Kids Zone prep: giant toothbrushes are ready”
- “Meet the Q&A wall”
- “What’s inside the free smile kit?”
- “Flossing myth: busted”
- “Parent guide mini-zine preview”
- “Smile booth backdrop reveal”
- “Countdown: 10 days to SmileFest”

Each post card should include:
- Placeholder visual block with gradients/shapes/icons
- Caption text
- Like/comment style icons as decorative static UI
- Tag pill

Make it look like an Instagram feed but clearly custom.

---

### 8. Featured Editorial Article Section

Create a big feature story layout.

Title: “The gentle guide to building a brushing routine that actually sticks”

Include:
- Large article card
- 3 numbered tips:
  1. Pair brushing with an existing habit
  2. Use a two-minute song or timer
  3. Celebrate consistency, not perfection
- Pull quote: “Healthy dental routines work best when they feel simple, visual, and repeatable.”

This should look like a magazine article preview with playful dental visuals.

---

### 9. Event Details Section

Static information cards:

Date:
Saturday, July 18, 2026

Time:
9:30 AM – 4:00 PM

Location:
Bright Hall Community Center, 124 Meadow Street

Who can attend:
Families, kids, teens, parents, caregivers, and anyone curious about better oral care

What to bring:
Comfortable shoes, questions for the dentists, and your best smile

Note:
“Sample event info for static demo website.”

Do not use real maps API. If showing a map, make a decorative static map card with shapes only.

---

### 10. FAQ Section

Accordion preferred but can be simple static expandable with Vue local state. No backend.

Questions:
- Is this a dental treatment event?
- Do I need to register?
- Is the event kid-friendly?
- Will there be free dental products?
- Can I ask private dental questions?
- Is the website connected to Instagram?

Answers should clarify it is informational/community education, not emergency care or diagnosis. The Instagram-style content is static mock content.

---

### 11. Footer

Include:
- SmileFest 2026 logo
- Short description
- Quick links
- Mini newsletter-looking input field but it should be decorative/static only. Button can say “Remind Me” but no submission/backend.
- Social-style icons as decorative
- Small disclaimer: “Static demo website. No appointments, accounts, payments, or live social integrations.”

---

## Interactions

Keep simple UI interactions only:
- Hover effects on cards/buttons
- FAQ accordion with local Vue state is okay
- Smooth anchor scrolling
- Mobile menu toggle if needed
- No complex animations required

Optional nice touches:
- Floating pastel shapes
- Tiny sparkle hover
- Scroll reveal with CSS only if simple

---

## Responsiveness

Must look good on:
- Mobile 360px width
- Tablet
- Desktop

Mobile priorities:
- Hero stacks nicely
- Story strip scrolls horizontally
- Schedule cards become one column
- Gallery becomes 2 columns or 1 column depending width
- Navigation remains usable

---

## Deliverable Expectations

Please implement as a polished static Vue website with clean components and styling. Use mock content only. The result should feel complete, playful, editorial, and event-focused, with an Instagram-inspired visual language but no external social media or API integration.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
